北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 2℃，风力 3级，出门添衣，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels 2℃ cold with Level 3 wind. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，体感 2℃ 略冷，北风 3级，出门记得多穿衣，注意防风！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny but feels 2℃ cool with a Level 3 northerly wind. Dress warmly and protect from wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，体感 5℃ 较凉。请减少外出，注意呼吸道防护哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze, feeling cool at 5℃. Limit outdoor activity, protect your respiratory system!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 11℃ 微凉，湿度高。出门带伞，注意添衣！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feeling slightly cool at 11℃ with high humidity. Carry an umbrella, add layers!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 13℃ 舒适，北风 3级，早晚温差大，记得加外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels pleasant at 13℃, but with Level 3 northerly winds. Mind the temperature difference!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 5℃ 较冷，北风吹拂。出门记得带件厚外套哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feeling 5℃ cold with a northerly breeze. Remember to bring a thick coat!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 3℃ 寒冷。请减少户外活动，注意防护哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze and feels chilly at 3℃. Limit outdoor activities and take precautions!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃，湿度 77%，有点湿冷。多喝热水，注意保暖！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels 9℃ damp-cold with 77% humidity. Drink hot water and stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 4℃ 湿冷，能见度低。出行请注意交通安全哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and feels 4℃ damp-cold with low visibility. Drive safely if you're out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 4℃ 略凉。早晚温差大，记得及时添减衣物！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feeling slightly cool at 4℃. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 11℃。湿度 67%，小心湿冷，别忘了加件衣服！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels 11℃. With 67% humidity, watch out for damp-cold, add a layer!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -15℃ 极寒，请务必严实保暖，谨防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels extremely cold at -15℃. Bundle up tightly to avoid frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -11℃ 寒冷，北风 2级，外出要多穿，注意防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels -11℃ cold with a Level 2 northerly wind. Dress warmly and stay protected!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 12℃ 舒适，紫外线强。记得防晒，保护皮肤哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels comfortable at 12℃. Strong UV, remember to apply sunscreen!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 9℃ 湿冷。湿度 71%，出门记得带雨具，防湿。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and feels 9℃ damp-cold. 71% humidity, bring an umbrella to stay dry.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 0℃ 寒冷，风力 3级。海边风大，注意防寒保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels 0℃ cold with a Level 3 wind. It's windy by the sea, stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -7℃ 刺骨，北风 4级。风大体感冷，多穿衣别着凉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels -7℃ biting cold with a Level 4 northerly wind. Dress very warmly!
